userStories.title: JP direct diffusion configs for insert and scoop
userStories.description: Create experiment YAML configs for insert_onto_square_peg and scoop_with_spatula using joint_position_direct action pipeline with diffusion head, DINO+Depth LoRA8 vision. These tasks have 0% and 20% replay ceiling with JV direct, so JP direct is mandatory. Use the existing sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jvdirect.yaml as template but change: (1) action_pipeline_preset to joint_position_direct, (2) action_representation to joint_position, (3) action_output_activation to identity, (4) action_min/max to actual robot joint position limits [-2.8973,-1.7628,-2.8973,-3.0718,-2.8973,-0.0175,-2.8973,0.0] and max [2.8973,1.7628,2.8973,-0.0698,2.8973,3.7525,2.8973,1.0]. Create two files: experiments/insert_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect.yaml and experiments/scoop_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect.yaml with task field set appropriately.

userStories.title: JP servo diffusion configs for insert and scoop
userStories.description: Create experiment YAML configs for insert_onto_square_peg and scoop_with_spatula using joint_position_to_benchmark_joint_velocity_servo action pipeline with diffusion head, DINO+Depth LoRA8 vision. This is an alternative to JP direct that keeps the benchmark JV interface but uses a servo adapter. Use servo params: gain=20, clip=1.0, steps=2, tolerance=0.01. Create: experiments/insert_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo.yaml and experiments/scoop_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo.yaml.

userStories.title: Close box separate gripper head with longer training config
userStories.description: Create an experiment config for close_box that combines: (1) DINO+Depth LoRA8, (2) diffusion head, (3) separate_gripper_head=true with gripper_loss_weight=4.0, (4) JV direct action, (5) 100 epoch training target. The hypothesis is that separating gripper from arm action improves gripper timing for close_box. Create: experiments/close_box_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jvdirect_splitgripper_e100.yaml. This should be same as the existing splitgripper config but explicitly noting it is for 100ep training.

userStories.title: Create unified 4-task JP experiment launcher script
userStories.description: Create a bash script scripts/start_jp_diffusion_4task_tmux.sh that launches same-env training for all 4 tasks using JP direct + diffusion configs on 4 GPUs (one task per GPU). The script should: (1) create a tmux session, (2) run each task in a separate tmux window with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, (3) use train_same_env_bcpolicy_probe.py with --epochs 50 --eval-episodes 20, (4) use the JP direct configs from US-001 for insert and scoop, and existing JV configs for slide and close_box. Make the script accept an optional run-name suffix argument.
acceptanceCriteria: Script creates a tmux session with 4 windows
Script uses CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for GPU assignment
